title: One line of a project's audit.jsonl: the assistant's work - each tool call with its arguments, the model, its result - and the versions accepted proposals and generations published (technical design section 11.2; spec Auditability). Project data: deleted with the project, never sent to the logs.

user.description: The person whose turn or decision it was

arguments.description: As the model sent them (parsed when they parse)

model.description: The model's id, or "application" for a call the application made

version.description: The deck version the call published (undo, redo, a generated deck)

versions.description: deck id -> the version an accepted proposal published
